$comment: Schema for /qa-test's summary.json (reports/tickets/{SPRINT}/<ticket-key>/summary.json). The ONLY narrative-adjacent artifact /qa-test persists (per .claude/rules/reports.md §1) — it must carry every field a later consumer needs: 1b's cross-sprint duplicate check reads `date`; 5e's Feature Release Gate reads `regression`; 5g records `promotion`. Replace <..> placeholders; 0/[]/null are empty defaults.

timing.$comment: Wall-clock for THIS /qa-test run. Per-suite durations are a different record and already live in reports/regression/history.json (durationField() in scripts/lib/regression-triage.ts derives them from the runner envelope) — do not duplicate them here. This block exists because the 40-minute regression window and the FAST/FULL split are both claims about cost, and before it the schema carried 78 keys and not one duration, so neither claim could be checked. regression_predicted_minutes is the makespan `regression:select --target` predicted; regression_actual_minutes is what the run took. An order-of-magnitude gap between them is the known ×18-×88 estimatedMinutes defect surfacing (see scripts/lib/suite-selection.ts) — record it, don't reconcile it away.

build.$comment: THREE version facts, not one, because they answer different questions and disagreeing on them produces the two worst QA outcomes available: filing a bug against a feature that was never deployed, and signing off a fix that never landed. `platform`/`theme`/`relevant_modules` are the DECLARED state (vc-deploy-dev backend/packages.json — git). `deployed` is what GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/modules actually reports — the ground truth, and routinely different (deploy in flight, failed, partially applied). A failed probe records the string UNKNOWN and NEVER falls back to declared. Full precedence rule: .claude/templates/agent-dispatch.md § Build Verification.

deployed.$comment: Probed, not read from git. UNKNOWN is a legal value; an absent/guessed value is not.

releasedThrough.$comment: Written by 1b item 2a from .claude/knowledge/domain/release-ledger.md. `ledger_generated` is that file's own `generated:` date — the run's freshness bound (stale after 45 days). `behind[]` lists components where deployed < released, i.e. shipped upstream but not testable here: those are NOT_DEPLOYED, never FAIL. `breaking[]` lists ⚠ BREAKING rows in the component(s) under test — a non-empty array is a FAST->FULL forcing condition (see 1b item 2a), so recording it is what makes that routing decision re-derivable afterwards. Empty arrays are the normal, correct state on a quiet month; null means the ledger was not consulted, which is a gap, not a zero.

epic.$comment: parent = the Epic this story belongs to (null if none). roll_up is written only on an --epic serial run (in the Epic's own summary), combining the child-story verdicts + the cross-story E2E into one Epic recommendation.

ac_dod_estimate.$comment: Filled by 5b. ac_coverage_pct = conditions_with_evidence/conditions_total. dod_* are null/0 when the ticket states no DoD (1e DoD field = 'none stated').

iterations.$comment: Only when invoked with --iterate. rounds = how many test(→fix→re-test) rounds ran (initial run = round 1); outcome = how the loop ended.

promotion.$comment: Filled by 5g (runs last, non-blocking). Cases are appended to regression/suites/ as Draft in Step 3; after Step 4's automated regression run 5g flips each promotable case Draft→Automated (green under the automated runner) or Draft→Reviewed/Manual (checklist-only), reverts non-promotable rows, and leaves a case that failed on a real in-scope bug at Draft with a reason.

blocked.reason: unresolved {HYPOTHESIS} — <what stayed unknown> | failed on in-scope bug <link>

regression.$comment: The change-scoped Artifact-C /qa-regression run — the Feature Release Gate (5e) is defined on THIS run_id, not whole-history.

regression_triage.$comment: Filled by 5a item 0 when Artifact C produced a RUN_ID. invoked = whether /qa-triage-results <run_id> --fix ran; the three arrays mirror its triage-report.md tables (confirmed bugs / test-case fixes applied / dismissed).

bugs_filed.$comment: One entry per confirmed bug filed at 5d.
